meta.name: pirate_vs_unicorn_isles
meta.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

programs.brief: A towering celestial unicorn colossus made of white quartz and amethyst crystal horn, standing defiantly upon the headland overlooking the strait with an arched entryway at its base.
A menacing skull-shaped sea fort built from blackstone and dark oak, featuring gunports, a skull jaw gateway, and crenellated battlements aimed across the water.
An elevated amethyst crystal obelisk with runic crying-obsidian pedestals and hovering crystal shards emitting protective wards.
A fortified shore redoubt with twin iron cannons on dark oak carriages, stacked powder kegs, and sandbag ramparts pointed across the water.

tokens.event_direction: pirate fleet and coastal batteries targeting unicorn island across the open strait
